method: Per-tape max intra-window inter-row silence + corpus-wide active-tapes per 30-min wall-clock bin. A GAP is flagged only when a >=1h intra-window silence COINCIDES with a corpus recorder-down window (active tapes collapse <=25% of local 3h median while >=8 neighbors active) -- distinguishing a recorder-down gap from an ordinary quiet-book overnight silence. Window-1 data is Jul 12-20, entirely after the Jul-6 disk crash (crash pre-dates the corpus).

arnrom.note: longest silence is an isolated quiet-book stretch (no corpus-wide recorder-down coincidence)
